 View Comments Noah Kahan performs at Fenway Park July 7. Patrick McCormack There’s no place like home for New England superstar Noah Kahan. 
 On Tuesday, the Grammy-nominated singer and Vermont native announced two additional Boston concerts as part of his 2027 “The Last of the Bugs World Tour.” Kahan will return to Fenway Park for a pair of shows June 21-22, heading back to the Hub following a quartet of performances at the historic ballpark May 29-30 and June 1-2. 
 A member of the Fenway Music Hall of Fame , Kahan made history last year as the only artist to sell out four consecutive nights at Fenway Park . Kahan is now set to perform a total of six shows when his world tour hits Boston next year. 
 It remains unclear why Kahan is choosing to headline the home of the Red Sox next year instead of Gillette Stadium, the larger and more lucrative of the local venues, considering the other US dates on his 2027 tour are slated for football stadiums.

Enter Email Sign Up Kahan’s 2027 tour will kick off at Georgia’s Sanford Stadium on April 24. In addition to the Fenway Park concerts, Kahan also revealed new dates for a pair of shows at New Jersey’s MetLife Stadium June 18-19, as well as two concerts at Detroit’s Ford Field June 9-10. 
 Outside of the US, Kahan has several shows planned for Europe, including dates in Berlin, Paris, and Milan. Kahan will also play two nights at Dublin’s famed Aviva Stadium July 17-18, and the iconic Wembley Stadium in London July 23-25. 
 Tickets for the tour, including the Boston shows, went on sale Tuesday afternoon for fans who registered for the artist presale. Eligible Spotify premium subscribers in the US will be able to take part in the “Reserved by Spotify” presale beginning Wednesday at 9 a.m. Meanwhile, general ticket sales for all tour dates will be available beginning at noon local time on Thursday at noahkahan.com/pages/tour .
